title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Line Review Training Questions: Late-History Share
content:
**What is the late-history share on a Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards line review?** The late-history share is 0.5 when the late fees assessed on the account with a transaction date fewer than 12 full calendar months before today, less the late fee reversals with the reversal reason assessed in error dated fewer than 12 full calendar months before today, number two or more; 0.75 when they number exactly one; and 1.0 when they number none.

**How does it act?** At the line review the line-review increase percentage is multiplied by the late-history share before it is applied to the current credit line.

**Which records are counted?** The account's late fee entries by transaction date within the span, and its late fee reversals carrying the reason assessed in error, dated within the span.

**Does a courtesy reversal of a late fee lower the count?** No. Only late fee reversals with the reason assessed in error are deducted.

## Count and share

| Late fees in the span, net of assessed-in-error reversals in the span | Late-history share |
|---|---|
| two or more | 0.5 |
| exactly one | 0.75 |
| none | 1.0 |

## Worked cases (hypothetical accounts)

| Late fees in the span | Assessed-in-error reversals in the span | Net count | Share |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | 1 | 2 | 0.5 |
| 2 | 1 | 1 | 0.75 |
| 2, one of them reversed as a courtesy | 0 | 2 | 0.5 |
| 1 | 1 | 0 | 1.0 |
| 0 | 0 | 0 | 1.0 |

A line-review increase percentage of 20 multiplied by a late-history share of 0.75 is 15.
